name: Suzakuin Ayaka
source:
The mother of the protagonist.

They were separated for a time due to his mother's infidelity, but she was assigned to the protagonist's school as a guest teacher. After the protagonist grew up, she turned her back on her family and became a career woman in the business world.

Her real name is Sawamura, but she calls herself Suzakuin, her maiden name because it is more convenient.

She is requested to be a special lecturer and is assigned to the protagonist's school.

That was the beginning of all the tragedy......
